name: Mathias
source:
He was Joshua's best friend. Known as a womanizer and flirted with a lot of girls. Met Daisy at a church service and tried to chat her up.
Seemed to be outgoing and popular.
[spoiler]He's actually in love with Joshua, but tried to hide as he considered it to be "abnormal". He's going out with girls to help himself forget about his true feeling. He felt jealous towards Daisy. Mathias later helped Cedric separating Joshua and Daisy/David.[/spoiler]
